summary.zh: 检验交付速度、研发招聘与值班安排
summary.en: Challenge delivery speed, eng hiring, team structure, and on-call.

description.zh: 在承诺交付节奏、扩充研发团队或调整值班制度前，检查排期依据、团队结构和人员负荷是否站得住。适合研发负责人审视其他部门提出的工程计划。
description.en: Checks whether delivery dates, headcount asks, team structure, and on-call rotations hold up before anyone commits to them. Useful for engineering leaders reviewing plans that come from other parts of the company.
